label: Aristotle, Metaphysics IV.1, 1003a21-26: There is an inquiry into being qua being and its…
interpretation: Formal-object reading: there is an inquiry whose subject is being qua being and which studies the attributes belonging to that subject in its own right. Being is left as a supplied formal object, not identified with a univocal genus or another fixed theory of being; the per se relation is likewise left uninterpreted.
